title: An affine Birkhoff-Kellogg type result in product spaces and its application to differential systems
summary: We prove a version of the Birkhoff-Kellogg theorem in product spaces, under affine transformations. This is a fairly natural framework that arises when dealing with parameter-dependent systems of functional-differential equations. We provide criteria on the existence of parameter-dependent solutions that have all the components nontrivial. The theoretical results are illustrated in the case of systems of second order functional-differential equations, where the functional part can cover the interesting cases of time and state-dependent deviated arguments.
